verified: Live, Aug 2026, against the Anthropic board. __reactFiber$ confirmed on #first_name.

match.notes: boards.greenhouse.io 301-redirects to job-boards.greenhouse.io (verified with curl). Embedded on company domains as <div id=grnhse_app> producing a CROSS-ORIGIN iframe; the host page carries ?gh_jid=<id>. my.greenhouse.io is an optional candidate profile, not needed to apply.

apply_url.note: The posting page IS the application form. No /apply suffix.

preflight_js.why: If the form is the cross-origin embed, refs may not cross the frame. Navigate to the iframe's own URL so the form is top-level.

on.EMBED_NO_IFRAME:<id>: human_queue - board token unknown, cannot build the embed URL

upload_first_why: Greenhouse does NOT parse the resume into the form (verified). No async overwrite race, so field order is free. Upload is placed after the text fields purely so a failed upload does not waste the fills.

fields.note: intl-tel-input. Write the E.164 value (+1XXXXXXXXXX) and let iti parse it. Only touch button.iti__selected-country if the flag ends up wrong; do not pre-click it.
input#resume.visually-hidden[accept=.pdf,.doc,.docx,.txt,.rtf] inside div.file-upload__wrapper. Hidden is fine - read_page returns non-visible nodes.
Only exists after clicking the 'Enter manually' link. Skip when cover_letter_pdf was uploaded; the id is community knowledge, discover it at runtime if missing.

question_map.how: Custom question ids are per-JOB (#question_<question_id>), so never hardcode them. Discover, then map each label through answer_rules.
question_map.discover_js: (async()=>{const out=[];const seen=new Set();const root=document.querySelector('form#application-form')||document;root.querySelectorAll('label[for]').forEach(L=>{const id=L.getAttribute('for');if(!id||seen.has(id))return;let e=document.getElementById(id);if(!e)return;if(e.className&&/requiredInput/.test(e.className)){const alt=(e.parentElement||document).querySelector('[role=combobox]');if(alt)e=alt}seen.add(id);const tag=e.tagName.toLowerCase();const t=(e.type||'').toLowerCase();let type='text',sel=__css(e),opts=null;if(t==='file')type='file';else if(tag==='textarea')type='textarea';else if(tag==='select'){type='select';opts=[...e.options].map(o=>o.text)}else if(e.getAttribute('role')==='combobox'||/select__input/.test(e.className||''))type='react_select';else if(t==='checkbox')type='checkbox';else if(t==='radio'){type='radio_group';sel='input[name='+CSS.escape(e.name)+']';opts=[...document.querySelectorAll(sel)].map(r=>r.value)}out.push({id:id,label:__txt(L).replace(/\s+/g,' '),type:type,selector:sel,options:opts,required:/\*|required/i.test(__txt(L))||e.required===true})});return out})()
typical: Are you legally authorized to work in <country>? (react-select Yes/No)
Will you now or in the future require sponsorship? (react-select)
How did you hear about this job? (react-select, often required)
Have you previously worked for / applied to <company>?
Arbitration agreement acknowledgement (required dropdown or checkbox)
EEOC self-ID block: gender, race/ethnicity, veteran, disability - its own required react-selects

verify.how: plan() builds a single JS readback over every field it filled and compares against step.expect.
verify.fail_closed: Any MISSING, empty required field, or NO_OPTION -> human_queue. Never submit an unverified form.

submit.gate: db.claim(uid) must return before this click - it re-checks the tier-1 gate, auto_submit and the per-company caps. Irreversible.
submit.note: Submit control selector is community knowledge, not verified live. Confirm with read_page before clicking. Clicking fires the invisible reCAPTCHA Enterprise check.
submit.confirm: get_page_text and look for the application-received copy, or a URL change to .../confirmation

captcha.where: recaptcha.net/recaptcha/enterprise/anchor?...&size=invisible plus a g-recaptcha-response textarea in the form; executes silently on submit
captcha.risk: Scores badly from datacenter/VPN IPs and can escalate to an image challenge. Run in the user's own residential browser session.
captcha.never: No solving, no bypassing, no third-party solver.

blockers.iframe: Only when the employer used the embed option - see preflight_js.

do_not_touch.why: Hidden sibling of the react-select combobox, used only for HTML5 validation. Setting it fakes validity without committing a selection.
Captcha token field. Writing to it is a bypass attempt - out of scope, permanently.
Only click when you intend to paste cover letter text instead of uploading a file.
